target.title: fix(test): unit tests fail on built checkouts and live host configs while CI stays green
target.body:
Related: #100046

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the full test suite fails deterministically on developer and maintainer machines while CI stays green, blocking local `scripts/pr` landing gates. Two host-state leaks cause it:

1. After `pnpm build`, bundled-plugin manifest discovery prefers `dist/extensions`, which by design excludes externalized official plugins (e.g. qwen, excluded via `package.json` `"!dist/extensions/qwen/**"`). Tests that rely on manifest-driven endpoint classification — the DashScope cases in `src/media-understanding/image.test.ts` and `src/agents/model-compat.test.ts` — then fail in *any* built checkout, because `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/...` no longer classifies as `modelstudio-native`.
2. The `unit-fast` and `unit-fast-fake-timers` shards ran with `setupFiles: []`, so their auto-curated tests read the developer's real `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`. Any config key the branch's schema doesn't know (e.g. a key written by a newer local gateway) deterministically fails config-reading tests such as `src/agents/tools/message-tool.internal-source-reply.integration.test.ts` and `src/commands/status.summary.runtime.test.ts` with `Invalid config at ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`.

Both classes were hit repeatedly during the landing attempts for #100046 (13 gate runs on 2026-07-04/05); #100053 fixed the discovery half for lane-invoked runs at the gate level, but plain `pnpm test` in a built checkout still failed.

## Why This Change Was Made

Tests should be hermetic by construction, not per-invoker env. `test/test-env.ts` (the shared isolated-home installer) now pins `OPENCLAW_BUNDLED_PLUGINS_DIR` to the repo's source `extensions/` tree alongside the existing vitest trust opt-in, so discovery matches CI (no dist) regardless of local build state; discovery unit tests keep managing that env per case (`src/plugins/bundled-dir.test.ts` deletes/sets it explicitly). The fast shards get a new minimal `test/setup.env.ts` that installs the isolated test home without the shared setup's module mocks, preserving their no-mock/no-runner speed contract. Non-goal: the load-sensitive real-timer tests (ms-budget `vi.waitFor` assertions) are a separate follow-up.

## User Impact

Maintainers and agents can run `pnpm test` in built checkouts and on machines with live OpenClaw configs and get CI-equivalent results; `scripts/pr` landing gates stop failing on these two deterministic classes. No runtime/product behavior changes — test infrastructure only.

## Evidence

- Root-cause chain for the discovery leak verified in source: `resolveBundledDirFromPackageRoot` prefers `dist/extensions` in built source checkouts (`src/plugins/bundled-dir.ts`), qwen is dist-excluded by design, and `resolveManifestProviderEndpoint` (`src/agents/provider-attribution.ts`) then loses the `modelstudio-native` endpoint class; `image.test.ts` fails with `expected 'Describe the image.' to be undefined`, and passes 29/29 with discovery pinned to source `extensions/` (verified 2026-07-05 in a built checkout).
- Config-leak failures reproduced with a live host config containing a schema-unknown key (`gateway: Unrecognized key: "terminal"`): the two unit-fast tests fail without isolation and pass with the isolated home installed.
- `bundled-dir.test.ts` unaffected: it deletes/sets `OPENCLAW_BUNDLED_PLUGINS_DIR` per case and restores the original value.
- Lane runs on the PR head via `scripts/pr review-tests` / hosted gates (see PR checks).
